note: The Hollow's fighting numbers (H0, the move arena, approved by Matt October 27, 2026; docs/future/16-the-sea-cave.md, Fighting, The lantern, The bestiary). Loaded by tools/move-arena.html?course=hollow only until H3; nothing in the game reads it yet. camera: the walker camera's numbers below ground (as recipes/world/walker.json camera), higher and further back so the floor reads; fade: walls and pillars between the eye and the walker (or the locked target) fade to fillAlpha with a soft outline instead of the camera pulling in; lockFrame: while locked, the view aims frameShare of the way from you to the target and turns to keep both in view at turnPerS (a share a second), sideDeg off the line between you so you never stand in front of it; the mouse still nudges it. lantern: fuel (a full lantern), burnPerS as it hangs and raisedBurnPerS while the right mouse holds it up, sipFuel what one hit costs (a sip), reachM how far its light reaches (raisedReachM held up, emberReachM snuffed), glintM how far past the light a thing still glints (lockable), ambient the chamber's own light (a share), strength the lantern's light on the page, raiseS how long the lantern takes to come up. lock: outOfReachS, how long a locked thing may stay out of the light before the lock drops. dot: the floor dot's range from the camera's tilt, farM at levelDeg (the camera's least tilt) and nearM at downDeg (its most), stepM how finely it walks the grid. swing: the staff's reach (m, from the walker's middle) and arc (degrees, centred ahead); sideDeg and backDeg: a hit from more than this off a thing's front counts as on its side, or its back. chains (Matt, October 27, 2026: one swing a click, chaining to the second and third): each combo clip cut into single swings round its strikes (segments, seconds of the clip; hits, the strike in each, found from the arm's speed peaks), played speed times faster; the walker stands anchored while one plays; a click during a swing chains the next, which starts chainAfterHitS after this one's hit lands; a click within chainWindowS after a swing ends also chains; otherwise it starts again from the first. hitStopS: the moment the world holds still when a hit lands; easeS: how quickly a swing blends in and out. hurt (Matt: no stunlocks): a hit on the walker staggers for staggerS (the hit clip played over clipS), then for graceS no strike lands. foes: the stand-ins' steps (rest, notice, close in, wind-up, strike, recover), timed from doc 16's table: noticeM, closeMps, strikeM (how near before the wind-up), windS (the tell), strikeS, dashM (a lunge's reach), hitM (how near a strike must end to land), recoverS (the opening), hp (hits to break), frontDeg (an armored front), size (small or large, for Taproot), instinct (the one the moves press on: movement, strikes at movement; toward, goes toward light; shy, shies from light), floats (off the floor, so Groundline passes under it), knockM (how far a landed hit knocks it back) and flinchS (how long it flinches: a hit breaks its wind-up or its lunge; a glance off the armored front only nudges it and breaks a wind-up). The watcher's callM: how far its call carries; turnDegPerS its slow turn. The motes keep out of the raised lantern's reach by keepOutM and dart in to nip.
